document_contents.quote: On examining the impugned order, it is clear that the tax proposal was confirmed because the tax payer failed to reply to the show cause notice or participate in the personal hearing.

defects_argued.quote: By taking this contention into account as also the assertion that the petitioner could not participate in proceedings because of being unaware of the same, the interest of justice warrants reconsideration subject to imposing terms on the petitioner.

outcome.quote: For reasons aforesaid, the impugned order dated 18.04.2023 is set aside on condition that the petitioner remits 15% of the disputed tax demand as agreed to within a period of two weeks from the date of receipt of a copy of this order.

review.notes: Equitable remand does not decide service validity. Registered post relates to intimation, not proven SCN service; portal claim retained as reported. No statutory demand section stated; provision remains null. Removed undated events.
